statement: Every build or release job MUST be placed only on a recently observed available node that satisfies the capabilities, resource dimensions, true workload visibility, explicit private-source egress grants, and provider-specific FREE-only quota. Unknown provider balances or stale observations MUST NOT be interpreted as zero expenditure or free capacity. Finite hosted minutes and multi-denomination provider credits, OCPU-hours and GB-hours MUST be held against authentic, fresh provider observations without overdrawing, before dispatch; paid spillover MUST be refused. Each job MUST have at most one live fenced lease holder, and build outputs MUST remain contested until independent agreement.
because: Leader, 2026-10-15T04:28Z: "WE HAVE LIMITED FREE GITHUB ACTION MINUTES STOP FUCKING PICKING FUCKING BETWEEN SHITTY ALTERNATES AND BUILD ACTUAL DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS THAT PICK BASED ON RESOURCES"; and 04:10Z: "we shouldn't need just bare cedar fog to do whatever everyone is trying to get it to do".
consumer: 561-group/bare-cedar-fog release workflow and the Kalshi trading service build

inputs: original job (needs, capabilities, visibility, closure, duration and bounded max)
original provider free-budget observations with scope, sourceRef, expiry and denominations
original hosted-minutes meter with actual used and observedAt
original scoped source egress grant for any private source crossing
specification.output: a placement naming the chosen node and every refusal with its reason
refusals: hosted minutes unknown, exhausted or stale
provider has no hard-stop free-only allowance
provider balance unknown/stale, units unmeasured, or would overdraw free quota
private source egress not permitted for the exact provider and account scope
specification.unknowns: An unadvertised quantity is an interval from zero to unbounded, never zero; a placement on such a node is marked for probing.
specification.evidence: Provider budget readback alone is not machine status. Original external provider/API must authenticate node, remaining quota, and cost rates; static Git node declarations are not live resource authority. No public source clone may qualify as proof of a private build.
